STAGE.md: 'On Windows and macOS run `flutter test --exclude-tags golden`: the golden images are made on Linux (ubuntu-24.04) and compared only there; refresh them with the workflow `update-goldens.yml`.'

flutter test --help (Flutter 3.47 on this machine): '-t, --tags  Run only tests associated with the specified tags.' '-x, --exclude-tags  Run only tests that do not have the specified tags.' Run in DonHang.App: `flutter test --exclude-tags golden components_golden_test.dart status_banner_test.dart` -> only the 5 banner tests ran, 'All tests passed!'; `flutter test --tags golden status_banner_test.dart` -> 'No tests ran. No tests match the requested tag selectors: include: "golden"'.

LocalFileComparator: 'loads golden files from the local file system, treating the golden key as a relative path from the test file's directory'; 'performs a pixel-for-pixel comparison of the decoded PNGs, returning true only if there's an exact match.' matchesGoldenFile: 'the rendered image of the first RepaintBoundary ancestor of the widget is treated as the image for the widget.'

flutter test --help: '--update-goldens  Whether "matchesGoldenFile()" calls within your test methods should update the golden files rather than test for an existing match.' autoUpdateGoldenFiles: golden files are 'automatically updated during tests rather than compared'; 'The Flutter tool will automatically set this to `true` when the user runs `flutter test --update-goldens`.'

LocalFileComparator/matchesGoldenFile: 'Custom fonts may render differently across different platforms, or between different versions of Flutter.' and 'a golden file generated on Windows with fonts will likely differ from the one produced by another operating system.' Lesson §4, §6 bullet 2 and q2 now use this wording.

LocalFileComparator: on failure it writes 'differential images contained within a `failures` directory', including 'the master and test images that were compared', an 'isolated diff' and a 'masked diff' (testName_masterImage.png, _testImage.png, _isolatedDiff.png, _maskedDiff.png). The lesson names no location; the ledger's 'next to the test file' is not stated in those words (page: 'generated in the same location specified by the golden key').

ci.yml job app: 'runs-on: ubuntu-24.04', working-directory DonHang.App, 'run: flutter test' (no tag filter); 'Keep the golden test failures' if: failure(), upload-artifact name: golden-failures, path: DonHang.App/test/**/failures/, if-no-files-found: ignore.

Ledger order '(light, dark)' is not what the lesson says and not needed.

matchesGoldenFile: 'This is an asynchronous matcher, meaning that callers should use expectLater when using this matcher'.

update-goldens.yml: 'on: workflow_dispatch:' only; job goldens runs-on ubuntu-24.04, working-directory DonHang.App, 'run: flutter test --tags golden --update-goldens', upload-artifact name goldens, path DonHang.App/test/design/goldens/; no commit/push step; header comment 'It commits nothing'.

GitHub Docs: 'To run a workflow manually, the workflow must be configured to run on the workflow_dispatch event.' '...run the workflow using the Actions tab on GitHub, GitHub CLI, or the REST API.' 'Select the Branch dropdown menu and click a branch to run the workflow on.' Lesson now: 'starts it by hand, for example from the Actions tab with Run workflow, picking a branch'.

GitHub Docs: 'You can visually compare images in three different modes: 2-up, swipe, and onion skin.' '2-up is the default mode; it gives you a quick glimpse of both images.' Lesson now says GitHub 'can show each changed image beside its previous version', which this supports (round-1 suggested wording adopted).

Opinion that follows from claims 4 and 5: the comparator only reports that the image differs (exact match), and --update-goldens makes any image pass. Stated in the lesson as the reasoning behind misconceptions 1 and 3, not as a documented fact.

Opinion consistent with LocalFileComparator's warning that 'a golden file generated on Windows with fonts will likely differ from the one produced by another operating system' and with the repo's choice (STAGE.md:68-70, dart_test.yaml).
